disclaimer_md: Research, not legal or compliance advice. Received funds from a sanctioned address is a factual on-chain statement, not an accusation. Exchanges may have frozen or reported funds. Labels are leads. No outflow found means within the data checked. Unknown observations are not zero.
event_retention: Display samples bounded by 2,000 transfers and 1.5 MB per address, further sampled for the 100 MB export budget. All issuer/designation/delisting events stay. Full saved-history monthly counts include omitted window and other transfers; truncation records their counts. Full row evidence stays in saved timelines.

movement_definitions.first_outflow_days: First qualifying outgoing transfer at/after T relative to noon ET T_pub, days. For backward compatibility the display point is null if its publication-day interval crosses zero. first_outflow_after_days supplies the signed noon proxy and first_outflow_lag_interval_days its uncertainty.
movement_definitions.frozen_before_listing_day: First issuer blacklist event strictly before the start of the OFAC date; derived from freeze-match lag upper bound, independent of transfers.
movement_definitions.last_outflow_before_days: Last qualifying outgoing transfer at any checked time before T, relative to noon ET; may be much older than the 7-day flag. Source example and interval exported separately.
movement_definitions.moved_before_designation: checkpoints.moved_before: qualifying non-dust recognized-asset outgoing transfer in [T-7 days,T), T=00:00 ET. Coverage-aware boolean; not derived from issuer logs.
movement_definitions.pre_week_test: Separate preregistered premove cohort: eligible complete non-Tornado histories with baseline windows; 7-day zero-shift activity and baseline use the saved premove method.
